newsitem.title: USA: Donnelly Corp shares trading on NYSE.
newsitem.headline: Donnelly Corp shares trading on NYSE.

text.p: Donnelly Corp said Monday its common stock has begun trading on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) under the symbol DON.N.
Donnelly Corporation stock previously traded on the American Stock Exchange under the symbol.

"We believe that our move to the Big Board reflects the company's growth and global expansion in recent years," Donnelly Chairman Dwane Baumgardner said in a statement. "The switch to NYSE will also provide increased corporate visibility to an international base of investors."
